snippet.title: Rode Clone using HTML and Tailwind CSS
snippet.description:
I have created this Rode Clone using HTML and Tailwind CSS.  I have resolved the Rode website issue i.e is responsive. As you explore the Rode.com  website, you can check that their images are draggable; this happens when you directly put a CDN URL to the image tag. I have resolved these issues in my Paytm Clone. 

If you liked it, click that like button and comment down that you liked it. 


source code: https://github.com/Hs809/Rode-Clone
live link: https://rode-clone-by-hitesh-pal.netlify.app/

You can also check out my blogs: https://hiteshpal.hashnode.dev/
